**Finding: Compliant (preferred position) — no redline proposed.**

The agreement contains no non-compete or field-of-use covenant binding us:

- **§ 2(a) (p0022/p0024)** affirmatively protects us: we are "not obligated to utilize the License and [are] free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system, design, formula, procedure or trade secret to provide software and services similar to the ones provided by TrueLink," subject only to TrueLink's IP rights and our existing Section 10 confidentiality obligations. Those are ordinary carve-outs, not business restrictions.
- **§ 8 (Client covenants)** is limited to legal compliance, access controls, content warranties and anti-spam; **§ 7** restricts only spamming. Nothing limits the businesses we may operate or the products we may buy or build.
- **§ 8(d) (p0054)** references a separate "Non-Competition Agreement," but here it operates as a *limitation on TrueLink's* use of Credit Data — in our favour, so not flagged. Noted in the rationale that the separate agreement is not in this document and should be reviewed on its own.
- The licence-scope language ("ordinary course of its business of the origination, underwriting, processing and funding of consumer finance receivables") defines permitted use of the Vendor's Interface, not a restriction on our activities.
